title: Checkout charges the pre-discount total after a promo code
why: The button says Pay $117.00 and the order goes through. Only the amount charged is wrong, and only when the promo is applied after the checkout page has loaded.
finding: `placeOrder` is memoized with `useCallback(…, [cart?.id])`, so it kept the total from before the promo. `POST /api/orders` sent `amount: 130` while the button read `Pay $117.00`, and order #10422 was charged $130.00.
actual: The POST /api/orders request body sends "amount":130 even though the pay button just read "Pay $117.00"; the server creates order #10422 with amount 130, and the order confirmation page displays "Total charged $130.00" with no discount amount shown — the applied WELCOME10 promo is silently dropped from the charged total.
expected: After applying WELCOME10 and seeing Total $117.00 / "Pay $117.00", placing the order should submit amount 117, and the order confirmation for Order #10422 should show the discounted total charged (e.g. $117.00 with the -$13.00 discount reflected), matching what the shopper agreed to pay at checkout.

rootCause.text: In src/pages/Checkout.jsx, the order submit handler placeOrder is created with useCallback(..., [cart?.id]) and posts amount: total (line 56) from its closure. total is derived as round2(subtotal - discount + shipping) (line 34) where discount = subtotal * promo.percent / 100 (line 32). When the WELCOME10 promo is applied, setPromo re-renders and total falls from 130 to 117, but because the only dependency cart?.id is unchanged, React keeps the previously memoized handler which still closes over the old total = 130. Clicking 'Pay $117.00' therefore executes the stale closure and sends amount:130 to POST /api/orders (verified: request body {"cartId":"1335c46e-06eb-495c-8e0e-9392c5d6dee8","amount":130,...} at 164639ms, after the promo was applied at ~150000ms), so the placed order records the full undiscounted charge.
